basis: Company-disclosed total respiratory revenue (all business units), USD millions
scope_note: This is company-wide respiratory revenue, not Point of Care only. Labs also carries respiratory volume. Respiratory bundles influenza, RSV and COVID-19; COVID is disclosed separately only for some periods and is NOT netted out here.
fiscal_calendar_note: QuidelOrtho reports 13-week fiscal quarters ending the Sunday nearest quarter-end (e.g. FY2026 Q1 ended 2026-03-29). Quarter-end dates below are as filed.
primary_source: QuidelOrtho quarterly earnings presentations, slide 'Revenue by Respiratory and Non-Respiratory'
cross_checks: Q4 2025 reconciliation line in the Q4 FY25 deck states total respiratory revenue $123.3 vs $143.2, -13.9% y/y, matching the grid.
10-Q filings state respiratory as a percent of total revenue each quarter (Q1 FY26: 11% vs 17%), consistent with 67.9/619.8 = 11.0%.
known_gaps: No respiratory split disclosed before 2023 Q1; Point of Care by business unit extends back to 2022 Q2 in the 10-Qs.
FY2024 figures were restated marginally between decks (POC 694.1 -> 694.6); values below use the latest published deck for each year.
COVID-19 revenue inside respiratory is disclosed only for scattered periods (FY25 total $80.2M); quarterly COVID figures in the 10-Qs may be year-to-date rather than discrete and were not used.
